sketchMechanisms: The `object` declaration creates a singleton — exactly one instance, ever, enforced by the compiler. Combined with Kotlin's `operator fun invoke()` returning Unit (void/nothing).
The Maybe monad's >>= (bind) operator propagates Nothing automatically — once any step yields Nothing, all subsequent steps are silently skipped.
The `never` type represents values that can never occur; a function returning `never` must not return. A variable of type `never` cannot be assigned any value.
